Financial Highlights

Performance at a Glance

The Company's performance over the past few years underscores the strength
and resilience of its operating model in a dynamic macroeconomic environment.
While evolving geopolitical conditions and project-related funding and finalisation cycles
have influenced the pace of revenue recognition and execution timelines, Afcons has
remained firmly focused on disciplined delivery.

Through strong execution capabilities, prudent cost management and a selective
approach to project participation, Afcons has consistently sustained operating margins at
~11%+, demonstrating the robustness of its business model and a steadfast commitment
to profitability.

The Company continues to maintain a healthy and well-diversified order book across
geographies and business segments, providing strong medium-term visibility and
reinforcing its confidence in delivering sustainable and profitable growth.

                               and equipment, the following factors are normally the most relevant:
                                                                                                                                                                               * Subsidiary on the basis of control on the composition of the board of directors.

                                                                                                                                                                               of Afcons Overseas Singapore Pte Limited.
                               - If any leasehold improvements are expected to have a significant remaining value, the Company is typically reasonably

                                                                                                                                                                               Afcons Contracting Company, which was formed on 1st August, 2024.
                               - The Company also considers other factors, including the costs and business disruption required to replace the leased asset;

                               - Most extension options in the leases have not been included in the lease liability, because the Company could replace the                           through

                               Significant actuarial assumptions for the determination of the defined obligation are discount rate, expected salary

                                             ` 11.02 Crore (decrease by ` 9.80 Crore) (as at 31st March, 2025: decrease by ` 6.65 Crore (increase by ` 5.98 Crore)).

                                                                                                                                                                    Critical judgements in determining the lease term

                                                                                                                                                                    In determining the lease term, management considers all facts and circumstances that create an economic incentive to exercise
                                                                                                                                                                    an extension option, or not exercise a termination option. Extension options (or periods after termination options) are only
                                                                                                                                                                    included in the lease term if the lease is reasonably certain to be extended (or not terminated). For leases of Land or Building
                                                                                                                                                                    and equipment, the following factors are normally the most relevant:

                                                                                                                                                                    - If there are significant penalties to terminate (or not extend), the Group is typically reasonably certain to extend (or
                                                                                                                                                                          not terminate);

                                                                                                                                                                    - If any leasehold improvements are expected to have a significant remaining value, the Group is typically reasonably certain
                                                                                                                                                                          to extend (or not terminate);

                                                                                                                                                                    - The Group also considers other factors including the costs and business disruption required to replace the leased asset;

                                                                                                                                                                    - Most extension options in the leases have not been included in the lease liability, because the Group could replace the
                                                                                                                                                                          assets without significant cost or business disruption.
